facts.text: Serve the snacks when Timothy Mouse offers Dumbo a peanut.
facts.why: In the transcript Timothy holds out a peanut to Dumbo, saying eat it, it has lots of vitamins, just before they go to see his mother.
facts.fix: Serve the snacks when Dumbo takes off in the big top and pelts the other elephants with peanuts.

facts.text: Dumbo, the magic feather was just a feather. You had the ears all along. Now eat your peanuts, pal.
facts.why: Timothy never says this. His real line is that the feather was just a gag, and it is the best one for the finale.
facts.fix: The magic feather was just a gag! You can fly! Honest, you can!

fix_note.text: The magic feather was just a gag! You can fly! Honest, you can!

vibe.verdict: A neat snack bar ticket look with popcorn and corn dogs, but the film's two best food moments, pink elephants and the pie filling, are left out.
missing: Pink Elephants on Parade after the champagne falls in the water vat (Dumbo and Timothy)
The clowns' fireman act and the vat of pie filling (the clowns)
The crows and the magic feather (Dandy Crow)
Casey Jr. puffing 'I think I can' (the train)
Mrs. Jumbo and Dumbo touching trunks through the bars (the visit)
Dumbo spraying the elephants with peanuts (the finale)
